images.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished square 1:1 Roblox experience icon, 1024 x 1024, for the original game "Multiverse Doomsday Tower Defense". This replaces an excessively busy fantasy montage. Art direction: a clean, confident professional Roblox game thumbnail, playful blocky R6-like 3D avatars, smooth plastic surfaces, chunky readable shapes, bright sunny blue sky, saturated emerald greenery, restrained cel-shaded edges, expressive faces, crisp render, readable at 150px. Show two heroic original units from the actual game: dominant foreground hero is a blue-and-white armored Roblox robot, white rounded block helmet with a single cyan visor, blue torso with one small yellow lightning emblem, white forearms/shins, large blue gauntlet thrust toward camera emitting ONE cyan plasma ring. Behind on the other side is a much larger muscular lime-green blocky giant with dark short messy hair, black/charcoal shorts, determined friendly angry eyebrows and huge square fist. They are defending against a single small stylized olive-green zombie at the far edge; no gore. Composition: the blue hero helmet and fist take about half of the image, green giant's head/fist about one quarter, clear separation, strong asymmetric diagonal action, very simple backdrop with just a faint path and a single green enemy portal. Leave clean spacing around silhouettes. Exact text: ONLY "DOOMSDAY" across the lower fifth in very large bold playful white/yellow lettering with a dark navy stroke, like polished Roblox cover typography, with all letters fully legible. No other words, no logos, no UI, no fake statistics, no rarity claims, no arrows, no money, no percentage badges, no borders, no watermark. No Marvel symbols, no red-and-gold armor, no flags or shield stars. No photoreal humans, no elaborate mechanical microdetail, no collage, no explosion wallpaper, no huge multiverse villain overhead. Make it look like an intentional clean Roblox render, friendly exciting tower defense, not a crowded movie poster. Important anatomy: coherent attached block limbs, clear fingers-free Roblox fists, helmet and giant face must not merge. Full bleed square image, keep faces and title away from all crop edges.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished WIDE 16:9 landscape promotional thumbnail, ideally 1920 x 1080, for "Multiverse Doomsday Tower Defense", an original cooperative Roblox tower defense. Clean professional Roblox discovery-thumbnail visual language: blocky R6-like avatars, polished simple plastic materials, vivid sunny blue sky, rich green grass, soft dimensional shadows, purposeful saturated color blocking. Keep it far simpler than an epic fantasy collage. Scene is a real-feeling tower defense battle in a stylized city park: ONE clear pale stone winding enemy path leading from a modest green circular portal at the far right toward a small green resistance bunker on the far left, with simple trees and two distant plain city buildings. Heroes placed on small defense pads beside the path rather than charging along it: a blue-and-white armored block robot as dominant main unit, white block helmet with a cyan visor, blue chest with one small yellow lightning emblem, white forearms and shins, blue gloves/boots; it faces right and fires ONE clean cyan plasma bolt from its outstretched gauntlet toward the foremost zombie. Next to it is a clearly larger lime-green muscular block giant with short dark hair, charcoal shorts and enormous fist mid-slam, one small simple ground impact shape. A smaller brown-haired hero wearing a forest-green sleeveless tunic and black pants holds a simple bow behind them. On the right, only THREE clearly separated olive-green blocky zombies walk down the curved path, one lightly armored bigger one leading, all humorous stylized child-friendly faces, no blood. Composition: simple left-to-right readable story, heroes grouped in the center-left, enemies to the right, lots of sky and visual breathing room, action effects limited to the single bolt and ground impact. Game title in a clean open upper-left section of sky, not covering heroes: exact three lines "MULTIVERSE" (small white), "DOOMSDAY" (large golden yellow), "TOWER DEFENSE" (small white). Bold playful chunky Roblox typography with navy outline and subtle depth, do not add a metal fantasy plaque. Title fully readable even small. Keep essential title/faces away from edges and above the bottom 15 percent. No other text, no numbers or wave claims, no rarity/chance badges, no big arrow, no cash, no loot piles, no UI, no watermark, no licensed brand symbols, no Marvel marks or red/gold superhero armor. No photorealism, no busy particle storm, no giant face in clouds, no carnival rainbow portal collection. A bright appealing actual Roblox-style cooperative defense game, clean purposeful thumbnail, matched blue/white/green palette to its square icon. One image, not a split sheet.
